# Executive summary

**Research question.** How accurately can 18 frog species be ranked using seasonal, environmental and geographic observations, and how much does model performance change under geographically separated assessment?

**Data.** We assess 242,600 complete-case FrogID recording events across 18 species with the common predictors and fixed three-fold validation splits.

**Model selection rule.** Primary: mean M4 spatial Macro-F1. Secondary: top-3 accuracy, balanced accuracy, MRR, model stability and interpretability. The winner is provisional until all five classifier families are complete.

# Problem, data and exploratory findings

The task is multiclass species ranking, not species-presence estimation. The classifiers are evaluated on the same complete-case events and 18-class vocabulary. The M0 species-prevalence baseline controls for improvement beyond class frequency alone.

# Modelling and validation methodology

The feature sets are: **M0**, no contextual variables; **M1**, four cyclical temporal terms; **M2**, M1 plus 21 climate terms; **M3**, M2 plus elevation; and **M4**, M3 plus latitude and longitude.

All classifiers share the same 242,600 observations, 18 species and three outer folds under both validation regimes. Random folds are class-stratified. Spatial folds group all observations from each 0.5° geographic cell. Hyperparameters are selected only on the preassigned inner fit/tune split of each development fold; assessment data are held out. Feature scaling, PCA and other estimated transformations must be fitted using training rows only.

# Results and model comparison

## Primary M4 spatial model selection

```{r m4-table}
display <- leaderboard[, c("rank", "model_label", "macro_f1_mean", "macro_f1_sd",
                           "accuracy_mean", "balanced_accuracy_mean",
                           "top3_accuracy_mean", "mrr_mean")]
knitr::kable(display, digits = 3,
             col.names = c("Rank", "Model", "Macro-F1", "Fold SD", "Accuracy",
                           "Balanced accuracy", "Top-3", "MRR"),
             caption = "M4 spatial cross-validation, unweighted mean of three outer folds")
```

```{r macro-f1-figure, fig.cap="Random and spatial validation comparisons. Whiskers show fold standard deviations, not confidence intervals."}
knitr::include_graphics(file.path(figures, "report_m4_macro_f1.png"))
```
